question: For each risk tolerance, what is the average number of holdings per investor, the average net cash-flow amount per investor (sum of signed cash-flow amounts), and the average risk score?

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average total holding value, average holding return and average holding gain (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value), and average dividends of investors.
sql_query:
WITH hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value) h_val, AVG(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.returns_pct END) h_ret, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.current_value - o.cost END) h_gain, SUM(o.dividends) h_div FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o GROUP BY o.investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_ret),2) AS avg_holding_return,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_gain),2) AS avg_holding_gain,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_div),2) AS avg_dividends,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average risk score, average liquidity score, average diversification score, and average goal-match percentage of investors.
sql_query:
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score,
       ROUND(AVG(h.liquidity_score),2) AS avg_liquidity_score,
       ROUND(AVG(h.diversification_score),2) AS avg_diversification_score,
       ROUND(AVG(h.goal_match_pct),2) AS avg_goal_match_pct,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across time horizon, compare the average rebalance amount, average rebalance shift (target minus current allocation %), and average rebalance count (0 for investors with no rebalancing actions) of investors.
sql_query:
WITH reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt, AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) r_shift, COUNT(*) r_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.time_horizon AS time_horizon,
       ROUND(AVG(rb.r_amt),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(rb.r_shift),2) AS avg_rebalance_shift,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(rb.r_cnt,0)),2) AS avg_rebalance_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.time_horizon
ORDER BY p.time_horizon;

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average net cash flow, average signed cash-flow amount, and average total holding value of investors.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net, AVG(amount) c_avg, COUNT(*) c_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     hold AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value) h_val, AVG(returns_pct) h_ret, SUM(current_value-cost) h_gain, SUM(dividends) h_div FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_avg),2) AS avg_cashflow_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average total holding value, average holding return (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value), and average scenario shift (new minus current allocation %) of investors.

FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance

question: Among investors with every component recorded, list the top 10 ranked by a composite score defined as net cash flow plus total sector investment (all components in INR); break ties by investor_id.

     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id)

     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift, COUNT(*) s_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     goals AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) g_prog, AVG(shortfall) g_short, AVG(avg_annual_return_pct) g_ret, AVG(avg_volatility_pct) g_vol FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_avg),2) AS avg_cashflow_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(sc.s_shift),2) AS avg_scenario_shift,
       ROUND(AVG(g.g_prog),2) AS avg_goal_progress,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance

question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average total holding value, average holding return (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value), average total rebalance amount, and average risk score of investors.
sql_query:
WITH hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value) h_val, AVG(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.returns_pct END) h_ret, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.current_value-o.cost END) h_gain, SUM(o.dividends) h_div FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o GROUP BY o.investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt, AVG(target_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) r_shift, COUNT(*) r_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_ret),2) AS avg_holding_return,
       ROUND(AVG(rb.r_amt),2) AS avg_rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(h.risk_score),2) AS avg_risk_score,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow, total sector investment and total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %). Over investors that have all 3 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 al.a_inv AS sector_investment,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(sector_investment) mn_1, MAX(sector_investment) mx_1, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_2, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_2 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (sector_investment-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0))/3.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.sector_investment,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: List the top 10 investors ranked by a composite score (0-100 index) combining net cash flow and total scenario allocation shift (sum of new minus current allocation %), with average goal shortfall counting against the score. WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     goals AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) g_short FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift,
                 g.g_short AS goal_shortfall
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL AND g.g_short IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_1, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_1, MIN(goal_shortfall) mn_2, MAX(goal_shortfall) mx_2 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (1-(goal_shortfall-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0)))/3.0,2) AS composite_score,

       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift,

question: What is the average annual return by investor risk tolerance, averaging each investor's goals first and then across investors?

question: For investors with a risk score above 50, what is the average annual return by segment?
sql_query: WITH g AS (SELECT investor_id, ROUND(AVG(progress_pct),3) ap, ROUND(AVG(avg_sharpe_ratio),3) asr, ROUND(AVG(avg_volatility_pct),3) avol, ROUND(AVG(avg_annual_return_pct),3) aret FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.segment, ROUND(AVG(g.aret),3) AS avg_val, COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS n FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id WHERE h.risk_score>50 GROUP BY p.segment ORDER BY avg_val DESC, p.segment ASC;

question: Among investors with a goal-match percentage above 50, which 10 have the highest average Sharpe ratio (also reporting their average holding dividends)?

question: For investors with an average Sharpe ratio above 0.0 and a goal-match percentage above 50, what is the average holding dividend by risk tolerance?
sql_query: WITH g AS (SELECT investor_id, ROUND(AVG(progress_pct),3) ap, ROUND(AVG(avg_sharpe_ratio),3) asr FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), ho AS (SELECT investor_id, ROUND(AVG(returns_pct),3) aret, ROUND(AVG(dividends),3) adiv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT p.risk_tolerance, ROUND(AVG(ho.adiv),3) AS avg_div, COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS n FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id WHERE g.asr>0.0 AND h.goal_match_pct>50 GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance ORDER BY avg_div DESC, p.risk_tolerance ASC;

question: What is the average net cash flow of investors who have an allocation above 0% in Automobile?
sql_query: WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(c.net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow FROM cash c JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p ON p.investor_id=c.investor_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 a WHERE a.investor_id=p.investor_id AND a.sector='Automobile' AND a.allocation_pct > 0);
